sloka: वसिष्ठस्य तु वाक्येन उत्थाप्य प्रकृतीजनम् ।किं करोमीति काकुत्स्थः सर्वा वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.१०७.११ ॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya tu vākyena utthāpya prakṛtījanam ।kiṁ karomīti kākutsthaḥ sarvā vacanamabravīt ।। 7.107.11 ॥

translations.english: And by the words of Vasishtha, Rama, having raised up the people, spoke to all, asking, "What shall I do?"
